name: Sybrava EMI & BOGO scheme
offers: Splits ~₹1.2 lakh/dose into ~₹15,000–16,000/month zero-interest instalments; 2nd injection free (buy-one-get-one).
how_to_access: Enrol at point of purchase via cardiologist. First-of-its-kind CV financing in India.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (Jan Aushadhi / PMBJP)
sponsor: Govt of India — Dept. of Pharmaceuticals
covers: Most off-patent generics across all 3 areas (metformin, amlodipine, statins, glimepiride, iron, etc.)
offers: Quality generic medicines at 50–90% lower price through 10,000+ Janaushadhi Kendras nationwide.
how_to_access: Walk in to any Janaushadhi Kendra; store locator at janaushadhi.gov.in.

name: Saath7
offers: Trained counsellors across 45 cities; in-person visits + daily telephonic counselling + virtual toolkits; ~100,000 patients/yr.
how_to_access: Doctor referral required; counsellor then enrols the patient. Not a free-drug scheme.

name: Changing Diabetes / Novo Nordisk Education Foundation
offers: Diabetes education, injection training, adherence support; access-&-affordability initiatives; 'Changing Diabetes in Children'.
how_to_access: Via prescriber / program partners. Education & access, not routine free medicine.

name: Lilly Diabetes & Obesity Support
how_to_access: Via prescriber. Formal savings/discount cards for Mounjaro are US-only.

name: Jardiance / Trajenta Support
offers: Adherence reminders, patient education for diabetes / heart failure.

name: Forxiga & Brilinta Support
offers: Post-ACS and diabetes/HF adherence, counselling and reminders.
how_to_access: Via prescriber; low-cost generics also available.

name: Xarelto Patient Support
offers: Anticoagulation adherence & patient education; INR-free monitoring guidance.
how_to_access: Via prescriber; many rivaroxaban generics available.

name: Amgen Patient Access (specialty)
offers: Access facilitation, injection scheduling & adherence support via specialty pharmacies.
how_to_access: Via specialist/specialty pharmacy. Confirm current program.

name: Novartis Patient Support
covers: Limited relevance here except Sybrava EMI (above)
offers: Subsidised access for select high-cost specialty medicines.

name: Specialty-pharmacy facilitators
covers: High-cost injectables: GLP-1s, PCSK9, denosumab, teriparatide, FCM, GnRH depots
offers: EMI/discounts, cold-chain doorstep delivery, and help enrolling in manufacturer PAPs.

name: National Family Planning Programme (Antara, Chhaya, Cu-IUCD, Mala-N)
offers: Free or highly subsidised contraception at public health facilities.

name: Anaemia Mukt Bharat / RMNCH+A
covers: Oral iron–folic acid, IV iron (iron sucrose/FCM) in programs
offers: Free IFA supplementation & anaemia management for pregnant/postpartum women and adolescents.

name: Fertility-cycle packages
sponsor: IVF chains (Nova, Indira, Cloudnine, etc.) & gonadotropin makers
offers: Injectable fertility drugs bundled into IVF/IUI package pricing; some clinics offer EMI.
how_to_access: Via the fertility clinic at treatment planning.

name: Thyroid & Osteoporosis Awareness
offers: Screening drives and patient education (e.g. 'Making India Thyroid Aware'); not financial assistance.
